Can I post a manuscript that is not in English?
How should I acknowledge the use of generative AI for writing my preprint?
How can I acknowledge my funders in my preprint?
What file formats are acceptable when submitting my manuscript?
What types of content can be posted on bioRxiv?
Can I choose more than one subject category for my preprint?

official_sources.policy_summary: Full computational research with methods and results is eligible; simple automated public-data analyses usually are insufficient. Articles must be English. Authors must disclose generative-AI use and remain accountable; AI is not an author. Use one subject category. Funding organizations and grants can use ROR lookup or free text. A single PDF is accepted; supplementary files remain as uploaded. Copyright stays with authors and CC BY is supported. An article already posted on another preprint server will not be posted.

already_satisfied.finding: English main has title, abstract, Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion, conclusions, 16 references, 5 figures and 2 tables; the supplement supplies full methods, source provenance, sensitivity results, 20 references and 6 supplementary figures. This is a computational research/reanalysis case, not solely a database-search list or software announcement. Scope assessment is an editorial inference; final bioRxiv screening remains separate.
Metadata title and abstract exactly match the current English main Markdown.

Sole author Sihuan Zhu, Anhui University of Chinese Medicine, ORCID 0009-0005-9705-0585 and correspondence email are present. Existing explicit author approval/responsibility is accepted; no coauthor approval is missing.

The main explicitly describes OpenAI Codex use in planning, retrieval, code development/execution, statistical and figure checks, drafting, translation and revision, followed by author review/approval and responsibility. AI is not named as author. This covers the official FAQ requirement; no repeated authorization request is needed.

The confirmed no-competing-interests statement and all three supplied grants are present. Funder non-involvement is not asserted. The funding text is available for the submission fields; absence of ROR IDs is not a missing user fact because free text is supported.

The main states public animal-data reanalysis with no new animal or human experiments and refers to source approvals. No clinical trial or new animal-approval number should be invented or newly requested for this submission. The public-data study still undergoes normal scope screening.

Metadata already selects CC BY 4.0 for the manuscript, a supported choice. Current preprint and journal statuses are not_submitted. The Zenodo record is a code/archive release DOI and must not be described as the future bioRxiv preprint DOI.

file_format_recommendation.route: Upload the final English main PDF as the manuscript and the separate English supplement PDF as Supplemental Material.
file_format_recommendation.why: Main PDF already combines text, tables and figures; this matches the accepted single-PDF route and preserves the previously reviewed layout.
file_format_recommendation.alternative: Word main/text and compatible separate figure files are accepted, but no conversion is needed when the reviewed PDF is used. TeX would require PDF conversion; it is not part of this package.
file_format_recommendation.supplement: Supplementary files are posted as supplied; use the reviewed 15-page English supplement PDF. Large computational data and code can remain in the linked archive rather than being reproduced inside the manuscript PDF.
file_format_recommendation.chinese_files: Do not use the Chinese manuscript as the bioRxiv submission. The FAQ directs readers seeking another-language material to the author or an external link.
file_format_recommendation.no_invented_requirements: No current numerical upload-size cap, mandatory cover-letter field, account postal-address field or special-template requirement was independently verified in an authenticated form; none is declared a blocker here. limitations: The authenticated submission form and account-specific mandatory fields were not inspected or operated. This review checks publicly documented requirements and prepared content.

The public FAQ warns that simple automated public-data analyses can be out of scope. The current controlled analyses, full methods and real outputs support research-article framing, but only bioRxiv can decide screening acceptance.
